name: llama.cpp on 8xMI300X: DeepSeek-V3 671B Q4_K_M prompt processing at 512-token prompts
methodology: Prompt processing (pp) throughput at -p 512, i.e. a 512-token prompt processed in batches of the llama-bench default ubatch size 2048 - so at 512 tokens the whole prompt fits in one ubatch. Command, repetitions and hardware as in llama-cpp-mi300x-deepseek-v3-671b-q4-decode-tok-s: 8x MI300X gfx942, -ngl 999, build 66906cd8, ROCm 6.4.0, 5 repeats, mean +/- sd. Value 439.14 +/- 1.68 tok/s. Sibling pp points: pp1024 = 439.02, pp2048 = 432.00, pp4096 = 420.19, pp16 = 47.71. OMITTED BY SOURCE: attention sink/implementation choice, flash-attention on/off, KV-cache size, thread count.
notes: Recorded mainly because it exposes the prefill/decode asymmetry that dominates inference economics on non-CUDA parts: 439 tok/s prefill vs 36.5 tok/s decode on the same model and the same 8 GPUs - a ~12x gap. On batch-1 single-stream serving you are decode-bound and pay for prefill you mostly do not use; on throughput serving the ratio inverts the calculus. Prompt processing also shows the classic small-batch ramp: 47.71 tok/s at pp16 rising to ~439 at pp512, then flattening and slightly declining to 420 at pp4096.
